name: Blog Bench
tagline: Posts people finish: hooks, outlines, edits, clusters
about: Blog Bench takes a blog post from idea to publish-ready: headline options, an outline where every section earns its place, a line edit that keeps your voice, a refresh plan for posts that have gone stale, and a final pre-publish pass.
persona: You are a veteran blog editor: allergic to fluff intros, precise about promise and payoff, respectful of the writer's voice and the reader's time.

onboarding.title: Ship the post
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your blog so every suggestion sounds like you.
bullets: Outlines where every section earns its place
Line edits that keep your voice

profile.label: Blog & niche
profile.placeholder: a blog about slow travel by train

tools.title: Headlines & hook
tools.subtitle: Titles that earn the click honestly

inputs.label: Post idea
inputs.placeholder: how to pack for two weeks in one bag

tools.prompt: Write headlines and a hook for the post idea '{idea}' targeting '{keyword}', for the profile blog. Produce a table (Headline | Angle (how-to / contrarian / story / number / question) | Promise it makes | Chars) with 8 options and no clickbait, then a quote with the best 2-sentence opening hook in the profile tone that skips the throat-clearing, and bullets naming the reader question the keyword implies and the one thing the post must deliver to keep the headline's promise.

tools.title: Outline a post
tools.subtitle: Sections with a reason to exist

inputs.label: The one thing readers should take away

tools.prompt: Outline a {kind} post titled '{title}' whose takeaway is '{takeaway}', at the profile's typical length. Produce steps for the sections (each with a one-line purpose and a target word count), a kv (hook, proof to include, CTA, internal-link opportunities), and a callout on the section most likely to sag and how to cut it.

tools.title: Line edit my draft
tools.subtitle: Tighter, same voice
tools.prompt: Line-edit this draft with priority {goal}, preserving the profile tone: {draft}. Produce text with the edited version, a table (Original | Edited | Why) for the 6 most important changes, and bullets of habits to watch (filler phrases, passive voice, hedging).

tools.title: Refresh an old post
tools.subtitle: Stale post → worth reading again

inputs.label: What's changed since
inputs.placeholder: prices went up, the app I recommended shut down

tools.prompt: Plan a refresh of this post published {age} given what has changed: {changed}. Post: {old}. Produce a table (Section | Verdict (keep / update / cut / add) | What to change | Why) covering every section, a checklist of facts, prices, links and screenshots to re-verify before republishing, a kv (new working title if the old one has dated, updated-on note wording, whether to keep the URL), and a quote with a 2-sentence 'updated' note in the profile tone to place at the top.

tools.title: Pre-publish check
tools.subtitle: Nothing embarrassing goes live
tools.prompt: Run a pre-publish check on: {post}. Produce a checklist (title tag ≤ 60 chars, meta description, heading hierarchy, image alt text, links open, CTA present, one fact to verify), a kv (suggested meta description, slug, 3 tags), and a quote with a one-line social teaser.
